scenes.h1: Will my child have the same teacher?
scenes.sub: Assalamu alaikum. Will my child have the same Quran teacher each week?

scenes.h1: A tested teacher whose hours fit yours
chips: Every teacher passes a recitation test
scenes.sub: We match your child with a tested teacher whose hours fit yours.

chips: Your child gets to know one teacher
scenes.sub: And we keep the same teacher wherever possible, week after week.
After six classes, you can keep the teacher or try another of the same standard, at no charge.
Every report from that teacher is on your family page.
